name: Incremental Load Balancing with Brick Caching
definition: A dynamic load balancing technique for distributed volume rendering that incrementally moves bricks between cluster nodes to correct imbalance, using a caching mechanism to reduce transfer costs when reversing moves.
summary: Incremental Load Balancing with Brick Caching is a dynamic technique that corrects load imbalance by moving one brick per frame, using a cache to reduce transfer costs and prevent oscillation.
